create_springwai_dataset: create a SpringWAI dataset instance with root directory, metadata dir, and train split for loading in-the-wild scenes
run_spring_dataloader_viz: run the spring dataloader script with rerun visualization to view sampled scenes, depth maps, and point clouds
load_spring_scene_views: load views from a Spring scene including image, depth, skymask, and moge2 prediction mask modalities
sample_spring_scene_views: sample N covisible views from a Spring scene using pairwise covisibility map for multi-view training
get_spring_dataset_stats: get dataset statistics from a SpringWAI instance to inspect scene count and configuration
